caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent blue glass jug centered on a plain, off-white background. The jug has a wide body that narrows to a slender neck, which flares slightly at the rim. There is one handle attached to the right side of the neck, curving outward and downward to connect to the shoulder of the jug, with a small decorative loop at the base of the handle. Subtle shading and highlights in varying shades of blue and turquoise indicate the reflective and translucent qualities of the glass, while the base of the jug shows additional shading to suggest depth. The drawing is contained within a rectangular border with thin black lines, and the bottom left corner within the border bears the text "Yolande DeLasser" in small capital letters.
title: Jug
